architecture:
System: Mission-API-089
Primary NIST family: Maintenance (MA); evidence focus: MA-3.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: an approved diagnostic utility is one version behind the preferred maintenance toolkit. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
